datasets.name: Semantic Scholar Open Research Corpus (S2ORC) STEM Subset
datasets.expected_sample_count: Target: 500k STEM papers (Cap: <20M samples, <20 GB payload)
datasets.notes: SKIPPED_TEMPORARILY: Official Semantic Scholar dataset API requires an authenticated API key (HTTP 401 Unauthorized for anonymous download). Full unpartitioned dataset is 30 x 4 GB (120 GB) or 30 x 6 GB (180 GB), exceeding the 20 GB hard cap. In strict accordance with Section 7 of the execution mandate, full-corpus download is prohibited. Acquisition will resume once an authorized Semantic Scholar API key is configured or a compliant pre-filtered STEM subset is provisioned.

datasets.name: LARIS-GOLD Epistemic Scientific Research Benchmark
datasets.notes: LARIS-GOLD is the project's internal gold-standard evaluation benchmark. As verified during audit, no pre-existing annotations exist in the repository. In accordance with Section 6.5, synthetic annotations are not fabricated. A formal project specification (DOC-SPEC-DATA-002) governs annotation schema, double-blind verification, and splits.

datasets.sample_unit: Multi-Hop QA Item (question, answer, context, supporting_facts)
datasets.notes: Fullwiki setting excluded: it repeats the same questions with retrieval context and its test split has no answers. Distractor already carries gold supporting facts.

datasets.name: Fact Extraction and VERification (FEVER) v1.0
datasets.sample_unit: Claim with SUPPORTS/REFUTES/NOT ENOUGH INFO label and Wikipedia evidence ids
datasets.notes: License is CC-BY-SA-3.0 (Wikipedia-derived), not MIT as in earlier spec. paper_dev/paper_test are subsets of labelled_dev and unlabelled_* carry no labels, so both are excluded. wiki_pages (281 MB) is not fetched: evidence resolution is deferred.
